record.name: Mailchimp
record.one_liner: An all-in-one marketing platform providing tools for email campaigns, automation, and audience management.
record.access_note: Developers can sign up for a free Mailchimp account and generate API keys or set up OAuth apps directly from their profile dashboard.
record.api_note: Mailchimp's Marketing API provides extensive coverage of lists, campaigns, automations, templates, and reports.

evidence.quote: Authorization using a Mailchimp API key (a.k.a. Bearer token)
All requests to the Marketing API use HTTP Basic Auth.
Creating a Mailchimp account is the first step to accessing our APIs and developer tools.
Mailchimp’s Marketing API powers timely, relevant marketing campaigns with custom data pulled directly from your app.
Every option for connecting an agent to that side of Mailchimp is community-driven
